rooms.format: Code rules on the user's message (steps.prepare_brief), checked before the understand patch is normalised. private_cues first: a match adds constraint no_dorm (dorm beds are never offered) and drops hostel; else dorm_cues adds constraint hostel (dorm beds may be any variant). Without either, a dorm bed may only be «Дешевле» for solo/friends when a private room exists (ranking).
rooms.no_hostel_format: Checked first (steps.hostel_refused): allow_hostel_cues drop constraint no_hostel; else no_hostel_cues, or «хостел» with a no_hostel_before negation within no_hostel_window_before characters before it (same clause) or a no_hostel_after negation within no_hostel_window_after characters after it (same sentence) and no no_hostel_except phrase there, add constraint no_hostel (every hotel of kind hostel and every dorm bed removed; implies no_dorm) and drop hostel.

location.format: Code rules on the user's message (engine._read_location_cues) for new_trip / refine / answer turns: a center cue sets prefs.center_max_m when understand did not (very_center_cues first: center_very_m, else center_m) and drops a prefs.district "walkable" understand set from the same words unless a walkable cue is there too. The centre component of the default fit (ranking center_*) applies to destinations of kind in ranking.center_kinds when the trip has no sea / beach / island wish and no prefs.beach_max_m.
location.near_format: prefs.near (engine._resolve_near): the place the user wants to stay near, resolved in the destination's pois (agent.places). near_cues: the words after one of them that name a poi set prefs.near when understand did not (an info question with a near cue and a search_cue becomes a refine before payment); near_drop_cues unset it; question_cues: the words after one of them name the place of a distance question («далеко ли от X?») -> the near_distance fact. Hotels: ranking.near_max_m is the relaxable hard radius, near_full_m / near_zero_m the score ramp.

best_time.format: Code rule (steps.best_time_facts, opendata.best_months): a cue in the user's message asks when to go. The card input carries the best months as ready Russian facts; without user dates the trip is assumed in the nearest best month (source inferred, a chip). Scoring: city_air full band / city_air_zero zero points of the day maximum for sightseeing, climate_fit for sea / warm / cold wishes; months >= keep_ratio x the best kept, at most max_months.

trains.format: Code rules on the user's message (steps.train_cues, after the rooms cues). any_train_cues first: a match drops the constraints train:sapsan / train:high_speed. Else sapsan_cues add train:sapsan, high_speed_cues add train:high_speed; either also sets prefs.transport = train. Ranking keeps only high-speed trains (the mock's train_kind high_speed) in each direction that has one, else relaxes it with a relaxed_pref risk.
trains.plane_format: Code rule on the user's message (steps.plane_cues): a plane_cues word at a word start, not negated (не / без up to two words before, «не» right after) and no plane_block_cues word in the message, sets prefs.transport = plane as the user's value unless the user already set the transport. A place without flights then gets «самолётов нет» with the train as a set_chip button (steps.recover_transport plane_fixed), never a silent train.
trains.long_format: Long-distance trains (the mock: Russian pairs 1000..2500 km, sleepers only, up to ~two days on board) are offered as a destination (budget-led inspiration, a train wish, other places) only when one way takes at most long_max_hours_per_night x the trip's nights (steps.long_train_fits_trip).

pets.format: Code rules (steps.step_info_lookup): with a pet in the brief, or a question with one of question_cues, the transport legs of the info facts carry pets_rule lines (from the offer's pets terms) and a pet_rules record carries general_ru. general_ru: RZD rules since 01.01.2025, cautious wording, no fees (fees are per offer and synthetic).
general_ru: В поездах РЖД кошек и небольших собак возят в закрытой переноске: сумма трёх её сторон — до 180 см, ставят её на место для ручной клади, на животное оформляют перевозочный документ, не больше двух животных на один билет.

В скоростных поездах («Сапсан», «Ласточка») — только небольших животных в переноске и только на местах для пассажиров с животными; в экономе переноска до 180 см по сумме трёх сторон, в бизнес- и первом классе — до 120 см и до 10 кг вместе с переноской. Крупных собак в «Сапсане» не возят, кроме собак-проводников.
В поездах дальнего следования крупную собаку везут только в отдельном купе: выкупают все свободные места, собака в наморднике и на поводке.
Собаки-проводники едут бесплатно во всех вагонах.
